project.title: GHES AI Code Review Lab
project.goal: Build a real AI code review demo for GitHub Enterprise Server: GHES on a VM in Indonesia Central, site-to-site VPN to Southeast Asia (AKS runners + MCP server VM), Microsoft Foundry in East US, plus a workshop site and narrated video.
project.note: Replay of the real lab run on 7 November 2026 (UTC+7). Times from 12:00 on come from the run logs; earlier planning times are approximate.

agents.name: Copilot
agents.title: Lead agent
agents.note: Plans the work, assigns lanes, reviews and merges.

events.detail: GHES on a VM in Indonesia Central, S2S VPN to Southeast Asia (AKS runners + MCP server VM), Microsoft Foundry in East US, plus a workshop site and narrated video.

How should agents at work be shown?

Deploy the lab with the GHES trial, screenshot every step, automate all of it
Signed in to GitHub. Go ahead and submit the form.

T3 done: trial confirmed, license file downloaded (stays in Cloud Shell and on the admin workstation)
Trial license (.ghl) copied into Cloud Shell; GHES 3.22.3 VM running in Indonesia Central
Management Console API: license, host name, admin SSH key accepted; configuration run 895c776e started
Runner image built in ACR without Docker: ghes-ai-reviewer-runner:202611070522
Tenant guardrail removed the management-port rule from nsg-ghes, even though it was IP-restricted
Decision: adopt the guardrail. GHES gets no public admin path at all; administer it from a private workstation
Private admin workstation vm-corp-ws01: no public IP, NAT gateway egress, driven by Azure Run Command
From the workstation: GHES resolves to 10.30.1.10, configuration finished, API reports 3.22.3
TLS upload rejected: 'certificate is not signed by a trusted CA'. Fix: install the Contoso lab CA on the appliance first
Runner image rebuilt with the Contoso CA: 202611070600
Deployment ghes-ai-lab succeeded in all three regions, API Management included
Foundry deployment gpt-review (gpt-5.6-terra) behind the API Management AI gateway, local auth off
Video workflow sign-in failed: AADSTS700213. GitHub now sends immutable owner and repo IDs in the OIDC subject
Federated credential added for the immutable subject; neural narration works with no keys
TLS + GitHub Actions apply 1727b03c started; Actions storage passed the precheck over its private endpoint
Federated credential added for the new OIDC subject format; video sign-in and narration work
First site admin and automation token created with headless Chromium (after replacing a network-idle wait)
Org contoso, repo contoso-orders-api, main protected: ai-review/foundry + 1 approval required
ARC scale set ai-review-runners deployed on private AKS; runner online on GHES
MCP VM trusts the lab CA; github-mcp + standards-mcp up; GHES over VPN: HTTP 200 in 0.087 s
Pull request #1 'Add year-end discount codes' opened on GHES
HTTP 400: function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported on /v1/chat/completions
Reviewer split into two phases: gather context with MCP tools, then reason without tools. Image 202611070645
Round 1: 25 s, 3 MCP calls. 1 critical, 5 high, 2 medium. ai-review/foundry failed, merge blocked
Round 2 after the developer's fix: 2 blocking, 5 findings (route still crashes, redemption never saved)
Round 3: 1 blocking, 2 findings (discount catalogue ships empty; the test hid it)
Round 4: 0 blocking, 1 low finding. ai-review/foundry passed; a human approval is still required
Starting T10: demo page, adoption guide, workshop modules and the narrated video from the real run
Screenshots pushed to ACR as an OCI artifact and imported to the site with GitHub OIDC
Demo complete on a real GHES. Next: publish the site and the narrated video
Video workflow: Azure AI Speech narration (keyless), scenes in headless Chrome, ffmpeg. 14 scenes
Narrated video committed: 4:33, 14 chapters, English captions
T10 merged: demo page with video, adoption guide, workshop and agent studio live on GitHub Pages
All 10 tasks done. The lab bills by the hour: run 99-cleanup.sh when the demo is over
